root_idea.summary: The root centers on completion: reaching a state free of deficiency and bringing something to full realization.
root_idea.development: From the basic idea of completeness, usage extends to fulfillment, full growth and fullness, completion of a period or undertaking, and things that supplement or finish an incomplete whole.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the Form I verb تَمَّ, the intransitive completion branch attested in the Quran.
Displayed as the Form IV verb أَتَمَّ, the transitive causative completion branch.
Displayed under the normalized singular active-participle citation form مُتِمّ.
Displayed as the abstract noun تَمَام.

senses.definition: To become complete, whole, full, or free of deficiency; to reach completion.
senses.usage_conditions: An intransitive completion verb, used for something reaching its full state or a period reaching its appointed completion.

senses.definition: To complete or make whole; to bring an undertaking, rite, obligation, or other matter to full accomplishment.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive causative completion verb. With rites, covenants, duties, and other undertakings it can be rendered “perform,” “fulfill,” or “perfect” when the context emphasizes complete accomplishment.

senses.definition: One who completes, brings to completion, or perfects something.
senses.usage_conditions: The active participle of أَتَمَّ; in the Quran it describes the one who will perfect or complete a specified matter.

senses.definition: Completion or completeness: reaching a state free from deficiency, or the completion that makes something whole.
senses.usage_conditions: An abstract noun used for the completed state or for completion of a matter, including the completion of a bestowed benefit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become strong or hard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported extension of becoming complete, said of a thing that becomes firm or hardened.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reach, attain, or arrive at something, including eminence or the means of acquiring it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with إِلَى in a construction of attainment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To repair, betake oneself, or go to a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A directional construction; a cited poetic context is also interpreted as completing a pilgrimage while going to its destination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perform, execute, or accomplish an affair, fast, purpose, or intention.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive construction with عَلَى referring to carrying an undertaking through.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To persevere in something or continue firmly in a course of action or attitude.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَى, including perseverance in refusal, dislike, or disapproval.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be broken.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate reported vocalized form and lexical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become jaded, harassed, distressed, fatigued, or wearied.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported interpretation associated with the same vocalized form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To destroy something or bring it to its appointed term and end.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II causative use in which completion results in destruction or termination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give players their remaining share in the maysir game, thereby making the shares complete.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized maysir construction involving distribution of the remaining meat or shares.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hasten and finish the slaughter of a wounded person or animal; to make the killing certain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form II construction concerning the completion or securing of a slaughter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause a fracture to become complete, so that a crack develops or the broken parts separate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a fracture or bone; it can describe a pre-existing injury becoming worse through further breaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hang an amulet or protective charm on a newborn or young child.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related expression تَمَّمْتُ عَنْهُ العَيْنَ means repelling the evil eye from someone by hanging such an amulet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To adopt the outlook, affiliation, or settlement of the tribe of Tamīm; to claim kinship with it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II social and tribal-affiliation use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie or contend with another in completeness or perfection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III reciprocal construction concerning competition in excellence or completeness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become tall and full-grown, or to reach full height and blossom.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a plant as a Form IV growth development.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To complete the period of gestation or become near to giving birth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a pregnant woman or she-camel in this specialized Form IV construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone the remaining material needed to complete a woven web.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The material consists of tufts or lengths of wool, camel hair, or similar fiber.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come together in full numbers, arriving all together or one after another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VI use for a group that gathers into a complete company; it may also describe a group responding to a call and coming to someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or request the completion of a benefit, boon, or favor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X construction expressing seeking completion of a benefit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or request wool or camel hair needed to complete the weaving of a garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X construction involving a request for completing material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Stammering, indistinct or hurried speech, especially repeated or confused articulation of ت and م.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized speech term covering reiteration, indistinct pronunciation, or rapid jabbering that is difficult to understand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of hoe, axe-like implement, spade, or shovel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate nominal use of the vocalized form تِمٌّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Shorn goat hair, camel hair, or wool used to complete the weaving of a garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also denotes the material given to someone as the missing portion needed to finish a web.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The fullness of the moon; a full moon or the night of its completion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Conventional expressions use the noun for the full, brightly shining moon and its full-moon night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The longest or a very long winter night; by extension, a night that is long or tedious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression with a specialized nocturnal meaning, distinct from the ordinary abstract sense of completion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Completion or carrying through of a statement, including keeping to one's word without retracting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in an idiomatic expression about refusing anything except completion of what was said or intended.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A complement or supplement whose addition completes a thing or makes up its full amount.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for the missing addition that completes a number, collection, book, or other whole.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Strong, firm, hard, or complete and perfect in make or formation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a man or horse in descriptions of strength and well-formedness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported adjectival use applied to a man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A remainder or remaining portion of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use for what is left over.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An amulet, bead, or charm hung on a person as protection, especially against the evil eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer to the bead or necklace itself; the practice is described as one believed to complete or protect a child’s condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who stammers, repeats the letter ت, or speaks so rapidly and indistinctly that others have difficulty understanding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes a person characterized by the speech defect called تَمْتَمَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Complete, entire, whole, full, consummate, or perfect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective of completeness or perfection, including descriptions of a complete formation and of a faultless sentence or oath; it can also convey complete or wholly assigned possession in context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having completed the growth stage designated by a particular age term and reached the next stage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical age description for livestock, including a goat or bull at a specified transitional stage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place where the vein or cord of the navel is cut or terminates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pregnant female that has completed the days of gestation or is near the point of giving birth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized active-participial description applied to a woman or she-camel, distinct from the Quranic agentive use of مُتِمّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In maysir, one whose winning arrow repeatedly succeeds and who feeds the poor, or who takes the remainder to complete the shares.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized maysir term for completing the distribution from the slaughtered camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Consummate or complete ignorance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed adjectival expression; the source notes an orthographic distinction from المُسْتَتِمَّةُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who seeks wool or camel hair with which to complete the weaving of a garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participle describing the person seeking the missing material for a web.

cautions: Lane's primary material is indexed under the contracted heading تم, while the canonical QAC root is تمم; the lexical evidence has been assigned using the supplied root match.

The English contextual variants “complete,” “fulfill,” and “perfect” are treated as contextual realizations of the completion branch, with constructional distinctions stated where the lexical evidence supports them.
